details:
This update for cpupower fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-80663: tools/power/x86/intel-speed-select: Harden daemon pidfile open (bsc#1278335).

Changes for cpupower:

- Release to latest kernel-source including:
 * intel-speed-select: Harden daemon pidfile open (CVE-2026-80663 bsc#1278335)
 * cpupower: Fix incorrect size in cpuidle_state_disable()
 * cpupower: fix error return value in cpupower_write_sysfs()
 * cpupower: Fix a bug where the -t option of the set subcommand was not working
 * cpupower: Fix the snapshot-order of tsc,mperf, clock in mperf_stop()

package.name: cpupower
